title: blueplanet
tagline: visualization of interaction with your friends on-off chain date
description: Currently, on-chain identity is mainly developed based on social credibility (i.e. employment history, bank transaction history) and competence (i.e. contribution in DAOs).              However, we believe that the information about friendship you have also become significant, as web3-social grows. Especially in situations such as the following.
how_its_made:
lens protocol, the graph

Show who you are friend with, and how close are you. The more you interact with frens, the more the planet thrives.
